plan.title: Remediate dynamic eval usage in app.py
plan.root_cause: Dynamic eval can execute attacker-controlled code. Use explicit parsing and allowed operations.
plan.strategy: Replace dynamic eval with a safer method that only allows a predefined set of operations.
risks: Potential execution of malicious code if not properly sanitized
Increased attack surface due to dynamic execution
plan.expected_result: All tests should pass without any errors related to dynamic eval. The build command should complete successfully.

attempts.summary: Replace dynamic eval with a safer method that only allows a predefined set of operations in app.py.
